title: Spatial Visualization
question_text: Which choice shows this shape rotated the matching amount?
explanation_script: Which choice shows this shape rotated the matching amount?
Here is a shape. Imagine turning it by 90 degrees.
Here are the five answer choices, A through E.
The correct answer is C.
A rotation just turns the shape -- a flipped mirror image is different.
So the answer is C.
